description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' extending 'bsd_common' that gathers system information specific to OpenBSD within a larger system info framework. It includes methods for retrieving system uptime, network statistics, IDE device details, and provides an icon identifier.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class that collects system info for OpenBSD, extending BSD common functionalities, including methods for system uptime, network, and IDE info.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing regex patterns for parsing system info.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics by parsing netstat output.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Extracts IDE device information from kernel message logs.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the filename for the system's icon image.
